## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]

  open [url]                  open the browser

  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable, polished 3D Spider-Man web-swinging browser game from the terse user prompt "Spider-Man 3d Game", with a procedural sunset city, token-collection objective, desktop and mobile controls.

## Requirements
- User provided no explicit constraints beyond "Spider-Man 3d Game"; interpreted as a self-contained browser game.
- Must support Android/iOS touch controls with safe areas and no browser gesture conflicts.
- Must be verified in a real browser and inspected via screenshots, not just code review.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/JS/CSS project served on port 3002; Three.js r160 vendored locally at `vendor/three.module.js` (no CDN runtime dependency).
- Game design: collect 12 glowing spider tokens across a procedural 448m city; timer + localStorage best time; win overlay; synthesized WebAudio (no audio assets).
- Third-person camera, automatic nearest-rooftop anchor web-swing, Space hold to swing, Shift dive/sprint, E web-zip, R restart, touch joystick + WEB/JUMP/ZIP buttons.
- Procedural hero from Three.js primitives with web-pattern canvas textures, spider chest/back emblems, animated limbs; no external model licensing.
- City uses shared canvas window textures with UV-scaled tiling; instanced road dashes, lamps, rooftop props; procedural businesses/cars/skyline; shader sunset sky.
- Debug API exposed as `window.__webrush` (`game`, `player`, `city`, `camera`, `hero`, `tokens`, `cam`, `input`, `press`, `release`, `step`, `teleport`, `collectAll`, `attach`, `zip`, `start`, `restart`, `pause`).

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `js/main.js`, `js/city.js`, `js/hero.js`, `js/audio.js` implemented and loading without JS errors.
- Menu screen, HUD (objective, timer/best, speed, minimap, reticle, toast), pause and win overlays, touch UI, sound toggle.
- Web-swing physics working: jumps off rooftop, attaches to building anchors, gains speed up to ~45–50 m/s, auto-releases near apex, chain reattaches; wall grazes no longer kill swings (only impacts >32 detach).
- Spawn moved to rooftop edge facing downtown so first swing clears the roof.
- Token placement now avoids the spawn area (>46m) and is pushed above colliders; spawn computed before token generation.
- Visual tuning: exposure 1.34, brighter hemisphere/ambient/sun/fill, warmer emissive windows, window tiling changed to `unitU=10`, `unitV=15`, hollow extruded parapets (fixed solid slab bug), instanced rooftop props, helipad, lamp glow points, hero fill light.
- Hero eye lenses resized so face reads correctly; helmet/head now red with visible white lenses.
- Reticle hidden while grounded, moved to 46% height.

### Active
- Final visual/gameplay polish and end-to-end verification after latest city.js spawn/token refactor.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and verify the latest `city.js` changes (moved spawn block, distance-filtered token candidates, token-in-building fix) with no console/page errors; confirm no giant token-ring artifacts near spawn/menu.
2. Test token collection by teleporting near a token, then confirm HUD count/toast/flash; test `collectAll()` win overlay, final time, best-time persistence, and `SWING AGAIN`.
3. Test mobile layout (touch device emulation, 390x844 and landscape), joystick, WEB/JUMP/ZIP, safe-area positioning; capture screenshots.
4. Verify pause/resume, pointer-lock handling, restart, sound toggle, tower/roof collisions, zip, and dive.
5. Optionally capture final desktop/mobile screenshots and leave the server running.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete UI/overlay markup and import map.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: game loop, web-swing physics, camera, input, HUD, tokens, minimap, debug API; latest edits here.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/city.js`: procedural city, buildings, drop shadows, tokens/spawn, rooftop props, helipad, cars; just refactored spawn/token order.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/hero.js`: primitive Spider-Man rig, suit textures, lenses, web strand, pose animations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized thwip, wind, pickup, landing, pad music.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: comic-style UI, overlays, responsive/touch styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r160.
- `/tmp/opencode/test.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/shot.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/phys.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/face.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/proj.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/hide.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/hide2.mjs`, `/tmp/opencode/tori.mjs`: Playwright test scripts for screenshots, physics stepping, face close-ups, token diagnostics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: generated screenshots (`menu3.png`, `s_swing.png`, `face.png`, etc.).

## Important Context
- Local static server runs in tmux session `webrush`: `cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround && PORT=3002 node $RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs`; currently serving at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli` browser works only with `--browser chrome` (installed browser version mismatch error for bundled chromium). `playwright-cli open --browser chrome http://localhost:3002`.
- Direct Playwright scripts use `import { chromium } from '/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs'` with `executablePath: '/usr/bin/google-chrome'`, flags `--use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --no-sandbox`.
- Headless SwiftShader runs at ~5–10 fps; `dt` is clamped to 0.05, so wall-clock waits advance game time slowly. Use `__webrush.step(seconds, 1/60)` for deterministic physics tests.
- `THREE` is not global in page evaluations; use existing object constructors (e.g., `camera.position.clone()`).

- `city.js` code generation order now determines layout; changing random call order alters buildings/spawn/token positions.
- Git changes are uncommitted; no commit/push performed.
